preconditions.description: The length of the string is between 1 and 1,000,000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all('A' <= c <= 'Z' for c in stdin)
preconditions.description: The string contains only uppercase English letters.

postconditions.expression: vowels = {'A', 'E', 'I', 'O', 'U'} and kevin_score = sum((len(stdin) - i) for i, c in enumerate(stdin) if c in vowels) and stuart_score = sum((len(stdin) - i) for i, c in enumerate(stdin) if c not in vowels) and (stdout == f'Kevin {kevin_score}' if kevin_score > stuart_score else (stdout == f'Stuart {stuart_score}' if stuart_score > kevin_score else stdout == 'Draw'))
postconditions.description: Kevin's score is the sum of occurrences of all substrings starting with vowels, Stuart's score is the sum of occurrences of all substrings starting with consonants, and the output declares the winner with their score or 'Draw' based on the comparison of these scores.
